title: Water, Solutions, and Concentration Reasoning
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Solution concentration and water property data/model analysis using particle diagrams, concentration tables, and graphs. No mixing or chemical testing is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for thermochemistry, gas behavior, phase changes, and solutions
simulationVirtualLabReviewFocus: Solution concentration and water property data/model analysis
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the concentration container with solute, water, drain, and concentration display controls. Record the starting solute amount, solution volume, and concentration reading or color intensity. Change solute amount first, then reset or compare by changing water volume. Record how each change affects concentration and write the evidence-based concentration conclusion.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
